comparison.objective: Grind peppercorns with a pestle while holding the mortar still.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture stabilization and repeated forceful circular rubbing.
comparison.success_condition: Five rounds-equivalent of valid rubbing grind all peppercorns, after which the mortar and pestle are safely placed and released.
comparison.reason: Tests sustained rubbing and vessel stabilization rather than impact delivery through a coaxially held mandrel and recovery of fractured metal pieces.
